title: Keep the cache in sync with server pushes
acceptanceCriteria: A pushed rename shows in the list on screen at once, without a request
A pushed rename shows in the open detail at once, without a request
A created todo appears in the list on screen, and the current rows stay on screen while it refreshes
A list that was hidden when the todo was created isn't fetched until it's shown again; then its cached rows show at once and the new todo arrives
